name: Passage take page renders a five-point unipolar scale
description: The Passage assessment take page loads at question 1 of 28 with a five-point agree-disagree scale.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Passage take page

Verify the progress indicator reads '1 of 28' and the first question is a statement with a five-point numbered answer scale (options 1 through 5), with 'Strongly disagree' and 'Strongly agree' labels.
Click the number 3 option to answer the first question
Verify the progress indicator reads '2 of 28'.
